answer_1.quote: We propose a task called DimonGen that aims to generate diverse sentences that describe the relationships between a pair of concepts... To solve the above task, we propose a two-stage retrieval-enhanced method named MoREE...

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, Self-BLEU-4, Self-ROUGE-L, Distinct-4, Entropy-4, and Success Rate to evaluate quality and diversity of the generated sentences.

answer_4.quote: We conduct the human evaluation by asking three annotators to assign grades (up to 5) of the generated relationship sentences... We design three evaluation dimensions: quality, diversity, and grammar & fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated sentence on quality, diversity, and grammar & fluency using a 5-point scale.
